description: This PHP class 'UrlLang' manages URL language settings, subdomain language detection, and URL redirection logic within the Goteo project, utilizing Symfony's Request component and project-specific Config and Lang classes.

classes.name: UrlLang
classes.description: Handles URL language and subdomain management, including redirect logic and session cookie skipping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes UrlLang with a Request object, capturing path and host.

methods.name: skipSessionManagement
methods.description: Determines if session management should be skipped based on URL prefix matching.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Generates the appropriate host URL considering language subdomains and redirection rules.

methods.name: matchPrefix
methods.description: Checks if any prefix in an array matches the start of a given string.
